newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican Jan-June steel output 6.4 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Mexican Jan-June steel output 6.4 mln tonnes.

text.p: Mexican steel production in the first six months of the year rose 10.9 percent to 6.4 million tonnes from 5.8 million tonnes in the first half of 1995, the head of the National Iron and Steel Chamber said Monday.

"If we maintain the rhythm of production that has emerged since the second half of last year, 1996 could be another record year for the industry, in which we would achieve the goal of producing 13 million tonnes of steel," Julio Villarreal said at a board meeting of the Chamber.
Production of laminated steel in the first half of the year was 4.9 million tonnes, up from four million tonnes in the first six months of 1995.
Imports of laminated products during the same period fell 16.2 percent to 275,000 while exports were down four percent to 1.4 million tonnes.

"The drop in imports and exports compared with the rise in production of laminated products underscores the signs of recuperation that are beginning to emerge in the domestic market where there is demand for a greater quantity of steel products," a statement from the chamber said.

It said "Apparent Domestic Consumption" of laminated products -- adding output and imports and subtracting exports -- reached 3.9 million tonnes in the first six months, compared with 2.8 million tonnes in the same period in 1995.
Demand for flat products was up 57.8 percent at 1.8 million tonnes, while for non-flat products it rose 11.8 percent to 1.9 million tonnes.
